The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
translations.bsb: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
translations.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
translations.asv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
